title: Fast first sound — open an example and play it

steps.name: First drone
steps.note: Open the File menu and go to Examples.
There is our patch: a Complex Oscillator, a Quad Function Generator and a Quad Low Pass Gate, with just one connection for now — from the Complex Oscillator to the sound output.
Notice which tab you are on: Audio 1. The cable from the oscillator runs off to the right and ends at the Mixer / Output tab, because the mixer is on a page of its own.
Now click the Mixer / Output tab — and watch the cable. It leaves the same connection it was tied to, and comes in from the Audio 1 tab at this end.
This is the mixer. The oscillator arrives on channel one, and everything sums to the Master fader on the right.
And the Master fader sets how loud it is.
The space bar is the same switch, from anywhere in the rack. Press it once and the sound stops.
Press it again and it starts. Watch the ENGINE lamp.
Click Audio 1 to go back to the modules.
